meaning:
συν-ανα-παύομαι
[in LXX: Isa.11:6 (רָבַץ) * ;]
with dative of person(s), to lie down to rest with, sleep with. Metaphorical, to be refreshed in spirit with: Rom.15:32 (L, om.).†
(AS)

renderings.bsb: and together with you be refreshed

elsewhere.note: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.
